subject: Island vs Inline — sightline decision and staging plan for booth H7
messages:
From: ExpoOps <ops@showservices.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: H7 — floorplan options and sightline renderings

Hi Lauren / Jonas —

Thanks for confirming booth H7. Attached are three floorplan options for the footprint you reserved: Inline 10x20 (Option A), Island 20x20 (Option B), and a staggered island (Option C) that keeps the demo pit slightly offset to preserve the sightline from the main aisle. We also included high-level notes on loading windows and a recommended routing for crate delivery.

Quick highlights:
- Option A (Inline 10x20): lowest cost, visibility only from one side, easiest rigging.
- Option B (Island 20x20): best visibility, requires two dock escorts and 2 extra labor hours for riser assembly.
- Option C (Staggered island): compromise — nearly island visibility while leaving one side partially open for AV cabling and demo staging.

Attachments: H7_floorplan_options_v3.pdf (3 pages), sightline_renderings.jpg (4 images).

When you have a preference, we can lock the shipping window and allocate the booth manager.

Thanks,
Rob 
Expo Operations — ShowServices
ops@showservices.com
